packages.name: @tuix/jsx
packages.summary: JSX runtime and compile bridge for terminal apps.
packages.purpose: You write views with JSX. The package maps them to MVU components and starts the app.
packages.whenToUse: Use this package when you build a CLI or TUI with JSX. Import `runApp`, `Command`, and `Fallback` for app entry and routing.
mainConcepts: JSX elements map to view primitives such as `text`, `box`, and `flex`.
`runApp` compiles the root component and starts the runtime loop.
`Command` registers a CLI command scope with args and flags.
`Fallback` sets the view when no command matches.
The compiler detects interactive mode and extracts named state.

packages.name: @tuix/ui
packages.summary: High-level widgets for layout, forms, and display.
packages.purpose: You import ready widgets. The package gives styled components on top of JSX primitives.
packages.whenToUse: Use this package when you need widgets such as `Help`, `Button`, `Box`, or `Viewport`. Prefer these over raw primitives for common UI.
mainConcepts: Widgets use theme colors from `@tuix/themes` when you set a theme.

packages.name: @tuix/themes
packages.summary: Theme tokens and runtime theme switching.
packages.purpose: You define colors, type styles, and spacing as a theme. Components read the active theme.
packages.whenToUse: Use this package when you share colors across widgets. Wrap the app in `ThemeProvider` and call `useTheme` in components.
mainConcepts: `ThemeProvider` sets the default theme and custom themes.
`useTheme` returns the active theme and switch helpers.
Built-in themes include dark, light, nord, dracula, and vibes.
You can register a custom theme with `customThemes`.
